content.text: Nothing on your week today, and it's a wet one (90% rain), so I'd go indoors. Indoor open play gym at Riverbend Community Centre runs Saturdays 9 a.m. to noon, $6 per child, for ages 1 to 5, so it suits your 2-year-old. That's per their program page, and I haven't confirmed it myself. [link-187000]
